## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Prague, Czechia. It starts at Maiselova 5.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get set to explore the famous Charles Bridge and the Old Bridge Tower with this self-guided tour. Experienced tour guides have curated key pieces of information and the best route to appreciate Prague’s medieval marvel.
>
> You can add another perspective to your visit with optional VR glasses which open a whole new window to the past. The power of technology allows you to see Old Town Square and Prague Castle through different eras. If you want to immerse yourself in Prague’s past, don’t miss this extra.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.12. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
